policy_outcomes.description: Avenue Van Vollenhoven in Schaerbeek made car-free following open letter campaign; decision motivated by COVID-19 social distancing needs; resulted in increased pedestrian, cyclist, and child use of public space
Open letter campaign requesting Sundays Without Cars in Brussels during summer 2020; addressed to Elke Van Den Brandt; gathered 4,487 signatures
Open letter to Schaerbeek commune requesting priority for pedestrians, runners, and bicycles in public space allocation; gathered 833 signatures

political_relevance_summary: Open Letter addresses gaps in democratic participation by providing tools or platforms that enable citizens and communities to engage more directly in governance and decision-making processes.

movement_building_utility.notes: Open Letter directly enables organizing by providing tools for collective action, campaigning, or community mobilization.

generalizability_notes: Moderate generalizability. Open Letter operates internationally but is proprietary, so replication would require licensing or rebuilding rather than direct adoption.
